status: Original DDraw1 GetDC group passes with native GDI system-memory surfaces; complete Wine acceptance remains failing.
changes: RGB GetDC creates a native GDI system-memory surface over the actual CPU shadow, retaining native bitmap metadata and direct pixel aliasing. ReleaseDC flushes GDI and releases the DC/surface/kernel parent in order, then uploads to WebGPU and presents through the existing path.

Initialize both SDK surface-more links, the global-more prefix and owner process fields. All failed/partially allocated kernel constructions unwind handles and the display DC. Active native DCs are also released during final surface destruction.
Indexed DCs retain their explicit palette DIB and its prior upload/present path. Unsupported-format and Lock/DC contracts from batch52 remain.
